B.Tech

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Delhi is renowned for imparting state-of-the-art undergraduate education and preparing its students for real-world challenges. We attract the brightest students from the country who score very high ranks in the IIT-JEE, arguably the toughest entrance exam for any academic institution. Our graduates have done extremely well, whether it is managing large corporations, designing revolutionary products, or contributing to fundamental research.

Some reasons why you should consider joining us :

Strong Undergraduate Program

  • The undergraduate curriculum provides a strong foundation in all areas of computer science.
  • The recently revised curriculum reduces course load and places greater emphasis on design and projects. It emphasizes the need for independent thinking and encourages students to get involved in interesting and novel projects. In addition to their course projects, a typical undergraduate student does four projects during his/her stay.
  • The department has a state-of-the-art infrastructure for teaching and research. Students are encouraged to come up with ideas and the department provides all support to translate these into interesting projects. Many of our student projects have won awards in various competitions.
  • The undergraduate curriculum gives the students sufficient freedom to specialise in any area of computer science they choose. The department has expertise in all the core areas of computer science and its faculty are well-known for their research.

Faculty Student Interaction

  • The department has a strong faculty, all PhDs from leading universities and active in research. The department also attracts a regular stream of visiting faculty members. Our faculty are diligently involved in training students and preparing them for the future ahead.
  • The students interact freely with faculty members on all matters related to studies. The curriculum gives them ample opportunity to work in close cooperation with any faculty member. Students are free to approach faculty for short-term (a summer or a semester) and long-term projects.

All-round development

  • Numerous sporting, cultural, academic and entrepreneurial events on campus provide students an opportunity to grow into well-rounded individuals.
  • The IIT campus provides a green and pollution-free environment and has facilities for various sports and extracurriculars.
  • IITD is located in the heart of the vibrant and lively city of Delhi. The campus is conveniently located and well-connected to all the attractions of the city including historical monuments, theatres, markets, and parks.
